full_prompt_en: A square, hand-drawn cartoon illustration inside a thin cream border shows a small green locomotive rolling along a rail track suspended above a town. An elderly man sits precariously on top of the engine, legs stretched forward and orange-brown shoes lifted into the air. He wears a soft green cap, round spectacles with thick rims, a blue-green coat, and olive trousers. A white beard and prominent pink nose make his side profile comic and easy to read. One hand grips the edge of the vehicle while the other extends in front of him as if keeping balance. The locomotive is boxy and overloaded with bags, crates, and small objects piled behind the seat. Dark little wheels, connecting rods, a round front housing, an orange buffer, and a small front lamp give the machine an invented yet legible rail shape. White smoke puffs rise at the rear and curl past a few tiny animals or decorative shapes perched among the cargo. The track runs diagonally from the lower center toward the right, with wooden sleepers visible beneath the rails and open air below. Far beneath, a miniature town is sketched in pale blue, tan, orange, and red rooftops beside a light landscape. A pale blue sky opens broadly across the upper right, with a soft cream cloud and warm haze near the horizon. Fine ink outlines and lightly mottled watercolor-like fills define the figures and mechanical parts; lines wobble slightly and small details crowd the left half, while the sky gives space for the odd vehicle to soar. The scene is playful and impossible, yet every wheel, rail, and posture supports the joke of a tiny overloaded train traveling at a dizzying height.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅置于细奶油色边框内的方形手绘卡通，画出一辆小绿机车沿悬在城镇上方的铁轨行驶。一位老人摇摇晃晃坐在车顶，双腿向前伸直，橙棕鞋悬在半空。他戴软绿帽、厚圆框眼镜，穿蓝绿色外套和橄榄色裤子；白胡子与突出的粉红鼻子让侧影滑稽而清晰。一只手抓住车边，另一只手向前伸，像在维持平衡。机车呈盒状，座后堆着包裹、木箱和小物件。深色小轮、连杆、圆形车头罩、橙色缓冲部件和前端小灯，使这台想象机器仍保留易辨的轨道车形态。白烟从车后升起，绕过货物间几只极小的动物或装饰形体。铁轨从画面下方中央斜向右边，钢轨下能看到木枕，下面则是空中。极远下方，一座微型城镇由浅蓝、棕黄、橙与红色屋顶勾成，旁边是淡色地貌。浅蓝天空在右上方宽阔展开，带一朵柔软奶油色云和地平线附近的暖霾。细墨线与轻微斑驳的水彩状填色界定人物和机械部件；线条略有晃动，左半部挤满小细节，天空则给古怪车子飞驰的余地。场景活泼而不可能，但每个车轮、轨道和姿态都支撑了这辆超载小火车在惊人高度上行驶的笑料。
style_prompt_en: Whimsical pen-and-watercolor cartoon illustration with fine irregular outlines, lightly mottled color fills, and playful mechanical exaggeration. Compact clusters of small objects and eccentric forms can sit against a spacious pale sky or other quiet field. Use cool blue-green and olive as structural colors, then add warm orange, pink, and tan accents to pull attention toward expressive faces and moving parts. Perspective may be deliberately precarious, with strong diagonals and exaggerated scale shifts, but the main action remains legible through clear silhouette and practical joints. Tiny background shapes provide height and context without competing with the foreground invention. Keep the paper slightly aged and the hand-drawn line lively rather than polished. The tone is humorous, inventive, and buoyant, finding fun in crowded detail set against airy open space.
style_prompt_zh: 诙谐的钢笔水彩卡通插画使用细而不规则的勾线、略带斑驳的填色和活泼的机械夸张。小物件与怪异形体可组成紧密团块，对照宽阔浅色天空或其他安静区域。蓝绿和橄榄色作为结构色，暖橙、粉红与棕黄则把注意力引向有表情的脸和活动部件。透视可以刻意惊险，带强对角线与夸张尺度差，但主动作依靠清楚剪影与可理解的连接保持易读。微小背景形状交代高度和语境，却不与前景发明争夺注意。纸面略带旧感，手绘线生动而非光滑精修。气质幽默、富于发明欲、轻快，从挤满细节的团块与透气空域的对照中取得乐趣。
theme_en: A whimsical cartoon of an elderly inventor riding a tiny green locomotive on rails high above a town
theme_zh: 诙谐卡通画里，一位老发明家乘着小绿机车沿高悬在城镇上方的铁轨行进
name: Don Martin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
